name: com.enzian.voiceprint
description: Low-latency on-device speaker identification (voiceprint) with Silero VAD + ECAPA-TDNN on ONNX Runtime: tells who is speaking from the microphone and returns each speaker turn's audio. Works offline on Meta Quest (Android), Windows and macOS. Install SileroVADForUnity (https://github.com/DIAOZHUO/SileroVADForUnity.git) first.

samples.description: Microphone speaker identification demo (uGUI) with three preset speakers and test clips.
